messages:
acme-admin: Hey team — after our SSO cutover I can log in but when I switch projects in the console I get a 403. Happens intermittently; sometimes logging out+in fixes it. Seen across 3 users in our org. Session ID: sess_9f3b. Request flow: SAML -> console -> redirect with RelayState.
elaine (Support): Sorry you're hitting this, thanks for the details. Can you confirm which IdP (Okta / OneLogin / ADFS)? Any custom rules on the SAML assertion?
acme-admin: Okta. We have long group lists (100+ groups). We noticed the URL after redirect sometimes looks truncated. I grabbed the browser logs:
```
GET /console/callback?SAMLResponse=PHNhbWw...[truncated]...k9==&RelayState=%2Forg%2Facme%2Fproject%2Falpha
status 302 -> then console shows 403 on project switch
```
acme-admin: The full SAMLResponse is ~25KB base64. Could the redirect be hitting some size limit and causing the assertion to be invalid?
idp-bot: Notice: Okta redirects via HTTP GET by default; many browsers and proxies impose URL length limits (~2083 chars). If SAMLResponse > limit, some parts may be dropped. Consider POST binding.
james (Infra): Interesting — our console callback endpoint accepts both POST and GET. We expect the IdP to POST the SAMLResponse to the ACS URL. If Okta is configured for redirect (GET) and the SAMLResponse truncates, the assertion signature will fail and the session will be partially established (session cookie created) but missing group claims. That would produce a login but with incomplete RBAC info -> 403 on resource access.
maria (SRE): I can repro locally by forcing a GET ACS with a large SAMLResponse: after redirect the session cookie exists but authz service returns 403 because group claim missing. I also see a propagation delta where our authz cache gets updated asynchronously — if the session is created without groups, the authz cache entry persists for ~30s before the downstream resync picks up the full assertion. That explains intermittent fixes when users re-login.
elaine (Support): Good repro — thank you. For the customer: can you check your Okta ACS (Assertion Consumer Service) binding? If it's set to "HTTP-Redirect", switch to "HTTP-POST" to avoid URL-length truncation. Workaround: have users reauthenticate with incognito/private window or clear cookies; that forces a fresh POST assertion.
acme-admin: Okta app was defaulted to Redirect due to old config. We'll switch to POST and test. For immediate unblock, can you give us a temporary manual resync command we can run from console?
james (Infra): For now, if you open console > Admin > Developer Tools (or give me the session ID), I can trigger an authz resync for sess_9f3b. But we should patch the callback to reject truncated GET assertions instead of accepting a partial session — that's a security/UX bug.
maria (SRE): Logged an infra ticket: INF-2026 — "reject truncated SAML via GET binding; improve error path to show explicit SAML assertion size/claim mismatch instead of generic 403." I'll add an alert and a short-term mitigator to force full reauth on group-mismatch.
elaine (Support): I'll update the support ticket with the repro, the suggested Okta change (Redirect -> POST), the temporary resync option, and the INF-2026 tracker. Can you confirm after switching to POST that the team still sees 403s?
acme-admin: Switched to POST binding, tested with 3 users — no 403s so far. Thanks all. Please keep INF-2026 high priority; we want users not to get confused by this. :thumbsup:
elaine (Support): Marking this as resolved for customer; keeping the internal ticket open for the pivot to stricter validation and clearer error message. Closing notes: repro steps, logs, session id, and workaround saved to the ticket.
